note: Alberta Parks campground on Winagami Lake, a 25-minute drive from High Prairie: treed sites a short walk or bike ride from the day-use area (playground, wading pool), boat launch and piers. The sani-dump is near the park entrance, a 2-minute drive away. --Claude
